title: Shaista Khan's Bengal Governorship
subtitle: Administrative expansion, trade control, and imperial consolidation.
summary: Shaista Khan's long governorship in Bengal oversaw military campaigns, urban-commercial growth, and tighter Mughal administrative control, including the Chittagong frontier shift.
heroTagline: Administrative expansion, trade control, and imperial consolidation.
whyItMatters: The period is key to understanding late Mughal Bengal's fiscal power, maritime politics, and imperial governance capacity.
